title: Final Diameter Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct diameter of the lens needed to separate the images of the two stars.

title: Final Grating Rulings
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct number of rulings required for the diffraction grating.

title: Correct Equation Use
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the equations for angular resolution and chromatic resolving power.

title: Mean Wavelength Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the mean wavelength used in the grating calculation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as 1.22 in the telescope equation, are included.
